title: Mack Hollins: Lands on injured reserve
text: The Patriots placed Hollins (calf) on injured reserve Saturday, Doug Kyed of the Boston Herald reports.

title: Keaton Mitchell: Mostly quiet in loss
text: Mitchell took six carries for 11 yards and caught three of four targets for 18 yards during Sunday's 23-17 loss versus the Broncos.

title: Jake Ferguson: Two catches during SNF
text: Ferguson caught two of three targets for 13 yards during Sunday night's 23-13 loss to the Packers.

title: Oronde Gadsden: Makes five catches in Week 4
text: Gadsden secured five of eight targets for 36 yards and recorded a two-yard carry during Sunday's 30-23 defeat in Seattle.

title: Kenny Gainwell: Handles three touches in loss
text: Gainwell rushed two times for 17 yards in Sunday's 26-19 overtime loss to the Steelers. He caught his only target for seven yards.

title: Chris Rodriguez Jr.: Logs 11 carries in loss
text: Rodriguez rushed 11 times for 55 yards while failing to reel in his only target during Sunday's 34-31 loss to Houston.

title: Malachi Fields: Catches both targets vs. Washington
text: Fields hauled in both of his targets for 20 yards during the Giants' 27-27 tie with the Commanders on Sunday.

title: Cade Otton: One catch in Week 6 loss
text: Otton caught one of two targets for four yards in Sunday's 26-19 overtime loss to the Steelers.

title: Evan Engram: Two catches in TNF win
text: Engram caught both targets for 13 yards in Denver's 17-14 overtime win over the Seahawks on Thursday night.

title: Ray Davis: Two big plays in Week 5 win
text: Davis caught his lone target for 31 yards while adding two carries for two yards and three kickoff returns for 114 yards during the Bills' 37-34 overtime win over the Rams on Monday.

title: Brian Thomas Jr.: Blanked in Week 6
text: Thomas didn't haul in either of his two targets during Sunday's 34-31 loss to the Texans in London.

title: Kaleb Johnson: Fumbles during crucial play in win
text: Johnson logged eight carries for 42 yards and lost one fumble in the Packers' 17-14 win over the Buccaneers on Sunday.

title: Jalen Nailor: One catch in return to action
text: Nailor caught one of four targets for nine yards during Sunday's 33-30 loss to the Bills.

title: Darnell Washington: Catches TD in win over Tampa Bay
text: Washington caught four of six targets for 25 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 26-19 overtime win over the Bucs.

title: Gunnar Helm: No catches in loss
text: Helm failed to catch his only target during Sunday's 26-3 loss to the Texans.

title: Cooper Kupp: Season-high 10 targets vs. Denver
text: Kupp caught five of 10 targets for 50 yards during the Seahawks' 17-14 overtime loss to the Broncos on Thursday.

title: Jakobi Meyers: Leading receiver in Week 6 loss
text: Meyers caught five of 10 targets for 83 yards in Sunday's 34-31 loss to the Texans.

title: Kalif Raymond: Quiet in Week 5 loss at Lambeau Field
text: Raymond caught three of four passes for six yards and logged one carry for minus-2 yards during the Bears' 31-7 loss to the Packers on Sunday. He also returned one punt for nine yards.

title: Marvin Harrison Jr.: Three catches in Houston debut
text: Harrison caught three of four targets for 34 yards in Sunday's 34-31 win over the Jaguars.

title: Brian Robinson Jr.: Limited workload in loss
text: Robinson rushed once for one yard while reeling in both of his targets for nine yards during Sunday's 31-23 loss to the Bears.

title: Pat Freiermuth: Two catches in Week 6 win
text: Freiermuth caught two of three targets for 11 yards in Sunday's 26-19 overtime win over the Bucs.

title: Dalton Schultz: Snags four passes in win
text: Schultz caught four of six targets for 33 yards in Sunday's 34-31 win over the Jaguars.

title: Kimani Vidal: Aonther TD in Week 5
text: Vidal tallied eight carries for 57 yards and one touchdown, one catch (on two targets) for minus-1 yard and returned three kicks for 75 yards during Sunday's 23-17 defeat to the Broncos.

title: Mike Washington Jr.: Leads team in rushing in loss
text: Washington rushed nine times for 43 yards in Sunday's 33-30 loss to the Bills. He added one catch for seven yards on one target.

title: Lamar Jackson: Could return to practice this week
text:
Ravens head coach Jesse Minter said Monday that Jackson could "potentially" practice in Week 7 and is still being considered day-to-day, Ryan Mink reports.

title: Alec Pierce: Not ready to practice
text:
Colts head coach Shane Steichen said Monday that Pierce (heel) won't have his 21-day practice window opened in Week 7, Nathan Brown of The Indianapolis Star reports.

title: C.J. Gardner-Johnson: Handed one-game ban
text: The NFL announced Monday that Gardner-Johnson has received a one-game suspension without pay for an act of unsportsmanlike conduct during Sunday's 33-30 win over the Raiders.

title: Nick Cross: Looks on track to play Monday
text: Commanders general manager Adam Peters said that Cross (illness), who is listed as questionable for Monday's game against the 49ers, is "trending in the right direction" to be available to play, Nicki Jhabvala of The Athletic reports.

title: Kayshon Boutte: Sees season-low snap share in win
text: Boutte finished with two receptions for 16 yards on three targets in Sunday's 34-31 win over the Jaguars in London.

title: Tank Dell: On track for season debut Week 7
text:
Texans head coach DeMeco Ryans said Monday that Dell (knee) is on track to return from injured reserve to make his season debut in Week 7 versus the Giants, Aaron Wilson of KPRC 2 Houston reports.

title: Rashod Bateman: Should be OK after exiting Week 6 loss
text:
Ravens head coach Jesse Minter said Monday that Bateman (shoulder) "should be OK" after exiting late in the second quarter of Sunday's 13-10 loss to the Browns, Jeff Zrebiec of The Athletic reports.

title: Blake Grupe: Heads to IR after Week 6 exit
text: The Rams placed Grupe (knee) on injured reserve Monday.

text:

text:
